mapper.select: SELECT hi.apt_seq AS aptSeq, hi.apt_nm AS aptName, CONCAT( COALESCE(dc.sido_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(dc.gugun_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(dc.dong_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(hi.road_nm, ''), ' ', COALESCE(hi.road_nm_bonbun, ''), CASE WHEN hi.road_nm_bubun IS NOT NULL AND hi.road_nm_bubun != '' AND hi.road_nm_bubun != '0' THEN CONCAT('-', hi.road_nm_bubun) ELSE '' END ) AS address, hi.avg_price AS avgPrice, hi.build_year AS buildYear, hi.latitude AS latitude, hi.longitude AS longitude FROM houseinfos hi LEFT JOIN dongcodes dc ON hi.dong_code = dc.dong_code WHERE hi.apt_seq = #{aptSeq}
SELECT DISTINCT pyung FROM apt_pyung_stats WHERE apt_seq = #{aptSeq} ORDER BY pyung
